ptxt.intxrefpoff: Rear Brake Caliper Disassembly and Reassembly

attention3.ptxt: Perform this inspection in the following cases.

item.ptxt: When replacing the brake pads with new ones.

servinfosub.title: Caliper and Caliper Carrier
servinfosub.ptxt: Check rear brake caliper and rear brake caliper carrier for deformation, crack, damage and rust. Replace rear brake caliper or rear brake caliper carrier if any defect is found.

servinfosub.title: Piston Boot
servinfosub.ptxt: Check piston boot (1) for breaks, crack and brake fluid leakage. If check result is not OK, replace piston boot.

servinfosub.title: Slide Pin
servinfosub.ptxt: Check that slide pins (1) move smoothly in axial directions before installing rear brake caliper to caliper carrier (3). Replace slide pins and pin boots (2) if check result is not OK.

servinfosub.title: Caliper
servinfosub.ptxt: Push in adjustment bolt (1) by hand. Then check that adjustment bolt moves in arrow direction when lever (2) is moved. If check result is not OK, replace rear brake caliper.
